in_marathi.name: Mahathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahathi is derived from the Sanskrit word Mahat, meaning great. The name is given to the goddess Mahadevi, who is considered the great goddess of strength and wisdom.
